messages:
Alex (AE): Heads up — Elmbridge wants HIPAA + 7yr audit log retention + HSM-managed keys. They want a 12mo committed Dedicated pool with a 3mo pilot. Can we bundle compliance into a flat add-on?
Sarah (AE): They asked for a single line item for compliance (no per-GB surprises). Asking for a capped fee and a 15% platform discount for the 12mo commit.
Mike (SE): Quick numbers from infra side: estimated logs ~5TB/year, daily exports, and HSM for key custody. Real cost drivers are long-term cold storage and HSM monthly rent.
Janet (SalesOps): FYI deal desk rule: up to 10% off list + standard add-ons ok without approval. Anything custom/risky (multi-year storage caps or >10% discount) needs deal desk + finance signoff.
FinanceBot: Rate card v3.4 (internal): https://redwood-internal/ratecards/v3.4 — audit-log-storage: $0.10/GB/mo after 1TB included; Managed HSM: $1,200/mo + $10k one-time setup; Compliance Pack (SOC2/HIPAA docs + 24/7 support): $18k/yr.
Alex (AE): Elmbridge pushing for flat $35k/year to cover 7yr retention + HSM + compliance bundle — they want predictability. ARR estimate for platform commitment ~ $1.2M.
Mike (SE): Two viable offers we can present: 
Option A (standard): list prices (storage @ $0.10/GB/mo after 1TB, HSM as above), no upfront cap.
Option B (bundle): 12mo committed Dedicated + flat compliance fee = $35k/yr, 12% platform discount for the commit, 3mo pilot waived billing, but customer must accept egress and export costs above 2TB.
Sarah (AE): They prefer Option B. Can we push through a 12% discount + flat compliance fee? They asked to remove the standard 30-day prepayment requirement for pilot.
Janet (SalesOps): Please submit a deal desk request with justification + competitive/customer strategic note. Need: ARR/ACV, expected go-live, pilot SOW, risk notes (long tail retention), and security questionnaire answers.
Alex (AE): ACV target = $1.2M; pilot SOW uploaded to the deal doc. Uploading security answers now.
Sarah (AE): Quick note — Legal flagged "export window" for 7yr retention. Need engineering to confirm export SLA and how we store cold archives (S3 IA, glacier-like).
Mike (SE): We can guarantee archived exports within 72h. For 7yr retention we use cold-tier object storage with lifecycle; cost estimate baked into Option B assumption.
Sam (Finance): From finance: $35k/yr for 7yr of effective retention on 5TB/yr looks low vs expected storage + HSM. We need margin calcs. Approve conditionally if customer covers egress fees >2TB/year or we tier the long-tail storage at cost + 10%.
Janet (SalesOps): Filing deal desk ticket DD-2026-412 with the bundle ask, discount request (12%) and pilot billing waiver. Attaching SOW, security Qs, link to rate card, and Sam's condition.
Alex (AE): Thanks @Janet — can you CC legal and @Sam so they see the SOW? Also flag as strategic: Elmbridge is likely EU expansion anchor.
Janet (SalesOps): Done — DD-2026-412 created and CC'd to Legal + Sam. Estimated review turnaround 48hrs.
Sarah (AE): I'll tell Elmbridge we have a conditional approval path and that deal desk should reply within 48hrs. :thumbsup:
Sam (Finance): If deal desk approves conditional terms, finance will prepare a short addendum that includes egress carve-outs and a storage tiering clause.
Alex (AE): Perfect. If approved, we aim to sign pilot PO this week. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
